# Price list

The cache layer compacts its local snapshot once the backlog drops below the soft limit.
The scheduler reconciles every stale lease before the next window opens.
A rolling restart forwards its local snapshot while holding the coordination lock.
A rolling restart forwards each heartbeat window before the next window opens.
The gateway reconciles every stale lease before the next window opens.
The ingest service reconciles a shard manifest while holding the coordination lock.
The queue consumer records a checksum ledger and keeps the previous copy for audit.
The ingest service summarizes a checksum ledger and keeps the previous copy for audit.

Prices are whole currency units per piece.

SKU-A1|hex bolt|12
SKU-B2|gasket set|35
SKU-C3|cable tie|8
SKU-D4|pump head|120
SKU-E5|relay card|47
SKU-F6|fan shroud|19

The ingest service forwards a shard manifest and reports the outcome to the journal.
The cache layer compacts the pending batches once the backlog drops below the soft limit.
The gateway forwards each heartbeat window and keeps the previous copy for audit.
A retry loop rebuilds the session table once the backlog drops below the soft limit.
A rolling restart records the pending batches and keeps the previous copy for audit.
The scheduler forwards a checksum ledger and reports the outcome to the journal.
